question: What harmful effects result from oblations performed with māṣa and with kodrava?
premises: Māṣa causes muteness and kodrava causes affliction with disease
inference: An oblation with māṣa makes one mute, and oblations with kodrava make one afflicted with disease.
plain_english: By an oblation with māṣa one becomes mute, and with kodrava one becomes afflicted with disease.
